lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 13 distinct white vertical line segments. The spacing is approximately 1.5 to 2 times denser in the anterior (shoulder) and posterior (rump) regions compared to the mid-torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Ventral merging of the third and fourth anterior lines is visible at the lower mid-torso boundary. Dorsal convergence of the ninth and tenth lines occurs at the spinal boundary.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The sixth line segment is a truncated vertical dash that terminates in the mid-torso. The last two posterior lines appear as discontinuous or dashed segments near the base of the tail.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: One large, high-contrast oval spot is positioned on the lateral haunch. Two smaller, lower-contrast spots are visible on the posterior portion of the upper hind limb.

other_distinctive_markers: White facial markings consisting of two circular cheek spots and a white patch on the muzzle. Prominent white patches are visible on the upper foreleg (knee area) and lower hind legs. A black dorsal stripe is visible extending down the tail.
